PullRequest.Title: sessions: restore inset bottom panel Pill tabs
PullRequest.Body:

## What changed

- Restore the shared 24px inset active surface for labeled Pill tabs in the Agents Window bottom panel.
- Keep the full-height indicator geometry scoped to Connected tabs.
- Add geometry assertions for default and compact Pill tab heights.
- Add production-backed Component Explorer fixtures for Pill and Connected presentations across default/compact density, labeled/icon-only modes, and Dark/Light/Dark High Contrast themes.

## Why

A generic Agents Window override applied Connected tab geometry to Pill tabs, causing the active Pill background to fill the complete 32px or 28px title row instead of matching editor Pill tabs.

## Validation

- `npm run compile` — passed
- `npm run hygiene` — passed
- `npm run typecheck-client` — passed
- `npm run eslint -- src/vs/sessions/test/browser/panelTabs.fixture.ts` — passed
- `./scripts/test.sh --run src/vs/sessions/test/browser/parts/panelPart.test.ts` — 6 passed
- Component Explorer render of `sessions/panel-tabs` — 24 fixtures passed
- Repeated Component Explorer render comparison — 24 fixtures, no differences

Scenarios.Scenario: Agents Window bottom panel renders, resizes, hovers, focuses, or switches labeled Pill/Connected tabs
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Browser selector matching, style resolution, layout, and paint for the existing tab indicator are on the UI critical path. The diff removes Pill overrides so Pill indicators inherit the existing 24px centered geometry and keeps transform:none only for Connected indicators; it adds no script, asynchronous prerequisite, or boundary call.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of visible bottom-panel tabs and frequency of ordinary tab-state/style changes; realistic cardinality is a small visible tab strip, with one existing indicator element per tab.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Browser rendering remains governed by the existing style/layout pipeline; the diff introduces no queue, task burst, or parallel work.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No application cache is involved. Normal browser style-rule and rendering caches apply identically before and after; no cache key or invalidation mechanism is added.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence from the CSS cascade and tests: Pill indicators now inherit top:50%, height:24px, and translateY(-50%); Connected indicators retain explicit full-height offsets and transform:none.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact browser paint/compositing cost varies by platform, but the changed declarations replace full-row geometry with the already-shared fixed-height Pill geometry and do not establish additional repeated layout or paint work.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The production diff changes static geometry only and neither increases element cardinality nor introduces synchronous DOM measurement, animation, layout loops, I/O, IPC, network work, or retained state.

Scenarios.Scenario: Component Explorer discovers and renders the new panel-tab visual fixtures
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Module registration creates fixture descriptors; when a variant is rendered, it synchronously creates local editor test services, two CompositeBar actions, two ActionBars, and a small DOM tree before screenshot/explorer display. This work is test tooling only and intentionally covers 8 presentations across 3 themes (24 renders in a full capture).
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Eight fixture definitions multiplied by dark, light, and dark-high-contrast themes, yielding 24 bounded variants; each variant has two tabs and three title actions.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The fixture render function starts no asynchronous operation or per-item promise burst. Capture-runner scheduling is external and unchanged by this fixture.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Fixture descriptors are created once at module load; each requested render intentionally gets an isolated disposable service/DOM setup. There are no cold/warm network, filesystem, or data caches and no negative-cache behavior.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence from defineComponentFixture/defineThemedFixtureGroup expansion and the render body: all work is local allocation and DOM construction, scoped to fixture execution and disposed through the fixture store.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The aggregate Component Explorer suite size and runner parallelism are not quantified, but this addition is a fixed 24 tiny test-only variants rather than input-dependent growth.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable performance regression. The bounded test-only coverage does not affect product startup or interaction, and no expensive boundary or unbounded/concurrent work was added.

Scenarios.Scenario: Sessions panel-part browser unit test validates default and compact indicator geometry
Scenarios.CriticalPath: After existing class/style mutations, the test synchronously reads additional bounding rectangles to assert indicator height and offset. These reads are on this one test's execution path only, not a product render/input path.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: One test DOM with two tab items; the diff adds a fixed number of geometry reads independent of user data or collection size.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The test is synchronous and introduces no concurrency, limiter, queue, or background task.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache is used or changed; browser layout state may be reused between adjacent reads, and no application cache behavior is involved.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence from the changed assertions: added getBoundingClientRect calls can require layout, but only in test code with constant cardinality.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Browser layout timing differs by environment, but the added work is fixed and isolated to a single unit test invocation.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The fixed test-only geometry measurements are necessary assertions and do not affect user-visible latency, throughput, memory, or rendering.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all three changed files and all diff pages. Traced runtime CSS rendering, Component Explorer fixture registration/rendering, and unit-test layout reads; no high-confidence diff-introduced performance regression or qualifying regression fix was found.
